key_points: Boeing CEO said 737 MAX production still unstable, raising near‑term concerns.
Stock fell >5% on the production news according to social media chatter.
Trump praised the 737 MAX after a Flydubai incident, offering limited political support.
Boeing secured a $20 B+ Navy F/A‑XX fighter contract, a major defense win.
Defense contract is positive but viewed as longer‑term and already largely priced in.
